headline: Itaú is building generative AI for its entire customer base
body: Itaú is applying its AI First strategy to customers and employees with ia.i, a conversational interface, and the IARA governance platform. The work sits in one of Brazil's most regulated sectors.
note: Pairing a conversational interface with a governance platform, for customers and employees alike, is the detail to watch in a regulated sector.

evidence.text: How Itaú is building generative AI for its entire customer base
With ia.i, a conversational interface, and the IARA governance platform, Itaú is applying its AI First strategy to customers and employees — in one of Brazil’s most regulated sectors.
